replies.author: ViceTechnicolour
replies.body: From what I saw, the room rooms seem too big and easy to camp. Defense is almost impossible when it comes to that type of size and materials used, and due to no pre-made defense or gap it seems like it'll be rushed rather easy. I reccomend making the rooms smaller and easier defendable, as well as maybe splitting the sides.
